title: Toggle reversion risk register — quick triage
body:
Purpose:
This is a lightweight, ad-hoc sheet for triaging feature toggles and quick reversion criteria during short-run rollouts. The goal: give PM/Eng/SRE/Support a single line per toggle with clear owner, concrete reversion triggers, and an immediate action plan. Use this for 24–72h rollouts where we expect quick decisions rather than a full postmortem.

How to use:
- Keep each toggle to one row. Add minimal quantitative estimates where possible.
- If risk is High, assign a live point-of-contact and a Slack incident channel.
- Reversion criteria must be specific (error rate thresholds, latency percentiles, business KPI delta).
- 'Last check' should be updated every 8 hours during the rollout window.

Columns: Toggle | Product area | Owner | Risk | Estimated impact | Rollout window | Reversion criteria (concrete) | Last check | Action items | Status

Rows:
1) hosted-api-rate-throttle-experiment | Hosted API | Priya Rao | High | Potential 8–12% request rejections at burst tail; customer-facing 5xx risk | 2027-04-01 -> 2027-04-04 | Revert if 5xx > 0.8% sustained over 10m OR p95 latency increase > 40% vs baseline | 2027-04-05 (09:10) | Watch SLO dashboard, CS standby, roll back to previous throttle config if triggered | monitoring

2) kv-prefix-cache-ttl-optim | Serving runtime / caching | Luis Martinez | Medium | Token cost down ~6% for chat workloads; risk of stale prefixes for multi-session flows | 2027-03-30 -> 2027-04-02 | Revert if user-reported coherence issues > 3 escalations in 24h OR error patterns in KV mismatch logs | 2027-04-04 (16:50) | Add temporary debug flag for logging sample keys, coordinate with RE to ingest traces | observing

3) embeddings-dedupe-filter | Embeddings infra | Evelyn Torres | Low | Small reduction in duplicate embedding units (est 2%) | 2027-04-03 -> 2027-04-06 | Revert if embedding quality regression on eval prompts > 3% or spike in downstream search mismatches | 2027-04-05 (08:30) | Run nightly eval set and push summary to #product-evals | running-evals

4) console-usage-force-optin | Console / UX | Aisha Kapoor | High | Could increase support tickets for first-time users (est +10%) | 2027-04-02 -> 2027-04-04 | Revert if CS ticket volume for 'console onboarding' doubles OR NPS survey drop > 0.5 points | 2027-04-05 (11:02) | CS to monitor and escalate; add banner with undo option in UI | watch-cs

5) dedicated-autoscale-policy-bump | Dedicated | Noah Patel | Medium-High | Potential cost increase for reserved nodes; throughput improvement expected | 2027-04-01 -> 2027-04-03 | Revert if cost per token increases > 12% month-to-date vs baseline OR tail latency improvement < 5% | 2027-04-04 (19:05) | Finance notified; set temporary budget guardrail; SRE to hold rollback playbook | finance-check

6) private-deploy-telemetry-optin | Private deployments | Marcus Chen | Low | Better telemetry for debugging; small privacy opt-in implications for a subset of customers | 2027-04-03 -> 2027-04-07 | Revert if any customer compliance request received or KMS errors observed | 2027-04-05 (09:00) | Legal loop-in; confirm telemetry anonymization doc link in support replies | legal-ok

7) default-quantize-small-models | Serving runtime / inference | Song Li | Medium | Cost down on small LLMs (~18%), potential minor output variance on edge prompts | 2027-04-02 -> 2027-04-05 | Revert if quality eval on canonical prompt set drops > 4% or customer escalations for hallucinations increase | 2027-04-05 (07:45) | Run nightly compare; gate via canary traffic routing | evals-running

8) batching-window-reduction | Serving runtime / batching | Sofia Nguyen | Low-Medium | Latency improvement for short requests; throughput per-GPU may drop slightly for batched workloads | 2027-04-01 -> 2027-04-02 | Revert if p50 latency increases for long-tail batch jobs or cost per token > baseline +7% | 2027-04-02 (22:10) | SRE to monitor, switch canary back to previous window if trend appears | reverted-if-needed

Open notes and unresolved questions:
- Need clearer definition of "escalation" for CS in several rows; propose simple 2-ticket threshold within 4 hours for automatic escalation.
- Are there regulatory considerations for private deploy telemetry opt-ins in EU regions? Legal said: review by 2027-04-06.
- Can we add an automated watch that posts to a dedicated Slack thread when a numeric reversion criterion is tripped? (SRE task; ticket INF-2106)

Quick timeline and owners for next 48h:
- 2027-04-05 09:30 standup (short): owners only (Priya, Luis, Evelyn, Aisha, Noah, Song, Sofia) — confirm last-checks and Handoff if needed.
- 2027-04-05 14:00 escalation drill if any criterion hit — SRE and CS on call.

Notes to self (working doc style):
- This sheet is intentionally terse. If a row becomes >2x longer than one line in 'action items', spin up a dedicated tracker and link it here.
- Keep the channel naming consistent: #toggle-triage-YYYYMMDD for the day.

Revision history (quick):
- 2027-03-22 Marcus Chen: initial template and first-pass rows.
- 2027-03-29 Luis Martinez: added KV cache and embeddings rows after infra spike analysis.
- 2027-04-04 Aisha Kapoor: updated console reversion criteria per CS feedback.

Quick links and references:
- Baseline SLO dashboard: https://observability.redwood/boards/slo-main
- Incident playbook (rollback steps): https://confluence.redwood.com/display/OPS/Rollback+Playbook
- Eval set for quantization: https://github.com/redwood-inference/evals/tree/main/quantize-small-models

If you're editing: add your initials and time next to the 'Last check' cell when you update. This is a high-noise document — prefer short, clear updates only.
